Hi guys (and gals, and non gender defined aetherous blobs).

I'm not really a remarkable guy. I occasionally write stuff. I occasionally make games. I occasionally do art or write music. None of it is terribly good.

There's a lot of subverses you won't find me on. They're the ones that popped up here because they were banned from another site.

Regardless, I fundamentally require freedom of speech in any platform I support. I've left a number of platforms over the years because I felt I wasn't free to speak what's on my mind.

The Internet has been getting scary the last few years. There's a lot of bullies out there who want to take an ideological disagreement and use it as justification for trying to destroy your life. They want to go after you.

That isn't the Internet I grew up with. My normal username is connected to me, personally. Thus, ever since I noticed this trend, I started using essentially random usernames, made up of the first 2 things I saw. Hence CabinetMosquito. I hope that someday we can return to sanity, where you can disagree with someone on the Internet without going after them personally.

I'm looking forward to interesting discussions with people. Lord, don't take anything I say that seriously, because arguing with people on the Internet is supposed to be a fun way to pass the time.
